observed_behavior: New commits reread every unchanged blob body before database deduplication; the live QA hook repeatedly spawned Git children for minutes.
expected_behavior: Only unindexed immutable blob bodies are read while every new commit retains its full tree mapping.
causal_mechanism: Full tree expansion supplied all blob IDs to body reads before persisted identities were checked.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Deduplication follows the expensive immutable-content acquisition boundary.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Database conflict handling avoids duplicate rows but cannot undo repeated Git reads and process startup.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: A committed repository-scoped immutable blob identity excludes another body read without excluding its tree mapping.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Query persisted identities before fetching bodies, remove them from the body-read set, and keep all prepared tree entries.

applicability_conditions: Immutable indexed objects are retained without historical garbage collection
New trees contain previously indexed blob identities
known_non_matches: An unseen blob still needs its body read
Idle database connection alone does not establish a deadlock
confirmation_evidence: Old preparation failed on a deliberately unavailable already-indexed fixture blob
Corrected preparation reads only the changed blob and preserves every tree entry
regression_proofs: tests/project-index.test.js: incremental commit preparation never rereads already indexed Git blobs
